title: Print Schedule: Certificate Reprint Charge on Address Amendments (Cardinal Financial Responsibility Filing)
content:
An older Cardinal Financial Responsibility Filing certificate is reissued in full when the address printed on it changes. The address-amendment reprint charge therefore follows the whole months from the filing's requested date to today.

| Whole months from the filing's requested date to today | Address-amendment reprint charge |
|---|---|
| 36 or more | 4.00 (full reprint) |
| At least 12 but fewer than 36 | 2.00 (partial reissue) |
| Fewer than 12 | None |

The requested date is the date on the filing's record on which the filing was requested; whole months are complete months counted from that date to today.

## Threshold pairs (hypothetical dates, today 14 August 2026)

| Filing requested | Whole months | Reprint charge |
|---|---|---|
| 15 August 2023 | 35 | 2.00 |
| 14 August 2023 | 36 | 4.00 |
| 15 August 2025 | 11 | None |
| 14 August 2025 | 12 | 2.00 |
